cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery, with at least one risk factor for postoperative complications
finding: Application of a single-use negative pressure wound therapy system to a primarily closed cesarean incision at time of surgery significantly decreased both deep and superficial infectious morbidity.
mod_finding: Application of a single-use negative pressure wound therapy system to a primarily closed cesarean incision at time of surgery significantly decreased both deep and superficial infectious morbidity.
